# --- Sink: 5-min tumbling window aggregation, partitioned by user_id ---
sink = (
    df.assign(window_start=df["event_time"].dt.floor("5min"))
      .groupby(["window_start", "user_id"], as_index=False)
      .agg(event_count=("event_id", "count"),
           amount_sum=("amount", "sum"),
           amount_min=("amount", "min"),
           amount_max=("amount", "max"),
           first_event_time=("event_time", "min"),
           last_event_time=("event_time", "max"))
)
sink["amount_avg"] = (sink["amount_sum"] / sink["event_count"]).round(4)
sink = sink.sort_values(["window_start", "user_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)

print("SINK OUTPUT (5-min tumbling, partition=user_id)")
print(sink.to_string(index=False))

sink_schema = pd.DataFrame({
    "field": sink.columns,
    "type": ["timestamp[UTC]","string","int32","int64","int64","int64",
             "timestamp[UTC]","timestamp[UTC]","double"],
    "nullable": [False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False],
    "role": ["window key (event-time)","partition key","agg","agg","agg","agg",
             "derived time","derived time","agg"],
})
print("\nSINK SCHEMA")
print(sink_schema.to_string(index=False))

# Integrity: sink must reconcile with source totals
print("\nreconcile sum:", int(sink["amount_sum"].sum()), "==", int(df["amount"].sum()),
      "->", sink["amount_sum"].sum() == df["amount"].sum())
